rationale: Both candidates correctly identify the central ground-truth concern (the unconditional vllm_c default now applies globally to ~14 diffusion models validated only on Qwen-Image), but X backs it with real verification (ran the new tests, checked numerics/strides, traced the sole caller chain) and layers on genuinely new grounded findings (stale RoCm logic, missing Part-2 regression test, Part-1-becomes-a-no-op-for-Qwen nuance) with concrete suggested diffs. Y restates the same scope point roughly five times across 'Validated' bullets and separate 'general' findings, and several of its entries are purely confirmatory (Cosmos3 override still works) rather than actionable asks, diluting its practical value despite good citation discipline.
